notes: VCA306 (v4 - real silent print): Chromium's silent print pipeline is broken on dad's KP307 driver - every variant (HTML, off-screen window, pre-rendered PDF) printed BLANK, while the Ask-each-time dialog always worked. Fix: bundle SumatraPDF (official signed 3.6.1, inside app.asar so it rides the normal update). For a silent job the app renders the slip to a PDF (proven correct on his machine) and SumatraPDF prints it straight to the chosen printer via Windows' own print engine - no dialog, real content, correct cut length. Ask-each-time still uses the working dialog. Note: this update is ~20MB larger. Needs on-hardware verification.
